title: Two Mountains Weighing Down My Chest (KINO)

title_lang.en: Two Mountains Weighing Down My Chest (KINO)

synopsis: Two starkly different cultural worlds, Berlin and Beijing, collide in this reflection on identity. Beijing born director Viv Li lands in post pandemic Berlin and immerses herself in the city's queer scene, an encounter that shakes her to the core and clashes with the traditional family values instilled back home, exposing how elusive self identity can be amid East West differences in a globalised world. This semi autobiographical documentary constantly asks "who am I", intercutting Berlin's dazzling nightlife, family dinners in Beijing and drunken heart to heart talks in New York, piecing together her own path through humour.

synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 柏林與北京，反映的是兩種迴異的文化體驗和經歷。生於北京的導演李蔚然在疫情後的柏林，親身領略這座城市的酷兒群體生活風貌，為她帶來前所未有的衝擊和震撼，與在北京時被灌輸的傳統家庭價值互相碰撞，展現的正是東西方文化差異及全球化語境下，要找到自我認同也未必容易。導演透過這部半自傳式紀錄片，不斷的叩問「我是誰」，柏林五光十色的夜晚、北京和家人共聚的晚飯、紐約醉酒後的真情對話，影像來回穿插，懶理世界如何，在幽默中拼湊出自己應走的道路。
